description: This file defines an Angular service class `ApiService` that provides methods to interact with backend APIs related to assets, tasks, and schedules, including CRUD operations and list filtering. It centralizes HTTP requests for a preventive maintenance management system frontend.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Angular injectable service providing API interactions for assets, tasks, and schedules.

methods.name: buildParams
methods.description: Utility method to construct HTTP query parameters from an object, excluding undefined, null, or empty string values.

methods.name: listAssets
methods.description: Fetches a list of assets, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: getAsset
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific asset by ID.

methods.name: createAsset
methods.description: Creates a new asset with provided data.

methods.name: updateAsset
methods.description: Updates an existing asset identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: listTasks
methods.description: Fetches a list of tasks, optionally filtered by status and assetId.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific task by ID.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new task with provided data.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: listSchedules
methods.description: Fetches a list of schedules, optionally filtered by assetId.

methods.name: getSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific schedule by ID.

methods.name: createSchedule
methods.description: Creates a new schedule with provided data.

methods.name: updateSchedule
methods.description: Updates an existing schedule identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Wrapper method to invoke the global confirm dialog, checking for its availability.

ctags.name: params
ctags.pattern: /^    const params = this.buildParams({ status: filter.status ?? undefined, assetId: filter.assetI/
